title: pyALDVC: Augmented Lagrangian Digital Volume Correlation in Python
description:
pyALDVC is an open-source Python implementation of augmented Lagrangian digital volume correlation (AL-DVC): local subset correlation coupled to a global smoothness step by ADMM, for full-field 3-D displacement and strain measurement from volumetric images (micro-CT, confocal and multiphoton microscopy, and other modalities). It ships a desktop application in seven languages and a command-line interface, masks drawn on the slices with subset splitting at boundaries, a texture analysis that measures the correlation length of a scan and the size of its representative volume element, strain post-processing, 3-D visualisation, checkpointed multi-frame runs, and readers and writers for the common volumetric image formats.

Each release on Zenodo corresponds to the tag of the same name on GitHub and to the version of the same number on PyPI (pip install al-dvc).
